description:
We are recruiting a full-time Backend Engineer for our client, a consumer mobile app ecosystem with registered users, all focused on education, personal, social and professional growth for people interested in continuous improvement and development.

What you will do

·       You'll make contributions to core backend domains like subscription and payment infrastructure, authentication, system architecture improvements (scalability, observability, CI/CD, etc.)

·       Partner with founders and product leadership to rapidly test product ideas while maintaining system reliability and avoiding technical debt traps

·       Propose and lead system improvement projects - like identifying areas where technical debt is slowing us down

·       Lead through collaboration - Code review, share your knowledge

·       Contribute to infrastructure - Help deploy services, launch servers, debug production issues, and keep our systems running smoothly as we scale

·       Leverage AI strategically - You understand AI is changing how we work and actively use it to boost your productivity and problem-solving.

About the technology stack and more information about the separate backend for each of the 3 applications of our client’s mobile app ecosystem:

  • the backend is developed in Python/Django, deployed in AWS (Amazon Web Services), and leverages PostgreSQL as the main database
  • Celery for asynchronous task, Cassandra for an activity feed and Elasticsearch to power the search functionality
  • integrations with payment systems (Stripe, Apple and Google), deferred deep linking providers, and others


All applications are strictly confidential. Only selected candidates will be contacted.

When applying, you consent to People Point SRL collecting, processing and storing your personal data. This will be used to provide information and advice, recruit, select, place, and mediate, in order to seek an employer interested in your professional services and to make statistical reports on the workforce, as required by law. This information will be stored in the People Point SRL database and can be transmitted to potential employers for whom People Point SRL will act as a proxy of a personal data operator. This personal data will be stored for 3 years, and you can request access to it, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, or portability, by sending an email to .
· Detailed information on how People Point SRL processes and protects personal data can be found in the “Terms & Conditions” section of the company’s website: www.peoplepoint.ro.
· You agree to participate in the recruitment and selection process (face-to-face and/or online interviews, role-playing games – if applicable, psychological testing, references from former employers, etc.) in order to complete the recruitment and selection file that will be stored in the People Point SRL database and/or made available to a potential employer.
nivel: Entry (0-2 ani), Middle (2-5 ani), Senior (5-10 ani), Executive (>10 ani)
